find_instance_center: find center points from a center heatmap using thresholding and NMS max pooling
group_pixels: assign each pixel an instance id by computing minimum distance to detected center points
get_instance_segmentation: get class agnostic instance segmentation from semantic labels, center heatmap, and offset predictions
merge_semantic_and_instance: merge semantic segmentation labels with instance segmentation to produce panoptic segmentation output
get_panoptic_segmentation: compute full panoptic segmentation from semantic labels, center heatmap, offsets, and thing category ids
